summary: AURAWEAR — an AI-powered fashion e-commerce platform and personalized fashion intelligence brand. Tagline: 'Your Style. Your Data. Your AI.' Targets 18–30 urban/Gen Z audience in India. Features agentic AI style agents, virtual try-on, wardrobe optimizer, trend radar, and an AI-driven shop search. Revenue model includes clothing sales, premium AI subscriptions, capsule wardrobe packages, influencer collabs, and B2B SaaS styling.
architectural_notes: Brand: AURAWEAR | Tagline: 'Your Style. Your Data. Your AI.' | Positioning: AI-powered personalized fashion intelligence platform
Target market: 18–30 urban Indians, Gen Z, college students, young professionals in metro cities
Core differentiator: Autonomous AI Style Agents (Style Twin, Occasion Agent, Wardrobe Optimizer, Trend Radar, Virtual Try-On)
Future roadmap: AI-generated custom designs, on-demand manufacturing, zero inventory waste, predictive demand production

existing_features.title: Build a homepage with: (1) a full-viewport hero section with headline 'Meet Your AI Stylist', tagline 'Your Style. Your Data. Your AI.', and a CTA button 'Start Your Style Journey'; (2) an interactive demo preview section showing a simulated AI outfit recommendation with a sample query input and 3 product card results; (3) a features section showcasing the five AI agents (Style Twin, Occasion Agent, Wardrobe Optimizer, Trend Radar, Virtual Try-On) with icons and brief descriptions; (4) a social proof section with 3 mock testimonials and brand stats (e.g. '10,000+ Styles Generated', '98% Fit Accuracy').

Build an AI Studio page (user dashboard) with four tabs: (1) Style Twin — form to enter body measurements and select style preferences (streetwear, minimal, luxury, casual, formal), save profile to backend, display current profile; (2) Saved Outfits — grid of outfits saved by the user, each showing product thumbnails and a remove button; (3) AI Suggestions — display personalized product recommendations based on the user's style preferences fetched from the backend; (4) Trend Alerts — display trending items personalized to the user's style profile.

Build a Shop page with an 'Ask AI' search bar at the top. When the user types a natural language query (e.g. 'casual black oversized hoodie under ₹2000') and submits, call the backend searchProducts function and display matching products in a responsive grid of product cards. Each card shows: image, name, price in INR (₹), category, available sizes, and an 'Add to Cart' button. Include a category filter sidebar (All, Tops, Bottoms, Outerwear, Accessories, Footwear).

Build a Wardrobe Optimizer page where users can: (1) add wardrobe items by selecting category and color; (2) view their current wardrobe as a visual grid; (3) click 'Optimize My Wardrobe' to call getWardrobeSuggestions and display recommended products as cards; (4) see suggested outfit combinations (groupings of 3–4 items) generated from their wardrobe.

Build a Virtual Try-On page with a 3D outfit visualizer. Display a static 3D avatar (using Three.js / React Three Fiber) that can be dressed with selected clothing items. When the user selects a product from the shop, it appears on the avatar. Show an auto-size recommendation panel based on measurements from the user's Style Profile (height, weight, chest). Display a simulated 'Returns Probability Score' (e.g. 'Low Return Risk: 94% fit confidence') based on size match.

Build a Smart Occasion Agent page where users type a free-text occasion description (e.g. 'I have a college fest next week'). The page parses keywords from the input (occasion type, formality, season) and calls searchProducts to return 3 curated outfit suggestions, each showing a complete look: top, bottom, footwear, and accessory. Display each outfit as a 'Look Card' with all items, estimated total price in INR, and an 'Add Full Look to Cart' button.

Implement a persistent shopping cart accessible site-wide via a cart icon in the navigation bar. Cart state is managed client-side (React state / context). The cart drawer/panel shows: item name, image, price, quantity controls, and remove button. Display cart total in INR. Include a 'Proceed to Checkout' button (checkout can be a confirmation screen — no payment integration required).

Apply a bold, futuristic dark-fashion visual theme across the entire application. Use a near-black background (#0A0A0A or similar), high-contrast accent in electric gold/amber (#F5A623 or similar), sharp sans-serif typography (e.g. Inter or Space Grotesk), and subtle glassmorphism card styles. Navigation should be a sticky dark navbar with the AURAWEAR wordmark logo. The overall aesthetic should feel premium, tech-forward, and aspirational — targeting fashion-conscious Gen Z users.

new_feature_requests.summary: Homepage with Hero Section 'Meet Your AI Stylist', interactive demo, real-time AI recommendation preview, and social proof
AI Style Twin (Digital Identity Agent): user uploads photos, enters measurements, links Instagram, selects style preferences to generate a dynamic evolving Style Profile
Smart Occasion Agent: user types occasion, agent checks weather, suggests 3 outfits with full styling, budget combos, and auto-adds items to cart
Wardrobe Optimizer Agent: user uploads existing wardrobe, AI identifies gaps, suggests essentials, creates 15+ outfit combinations
Trend Radar Agent: scans social media, influencer looks, seasonal color data, and search trends to recommend trending personalized pieces
Virtual Try-On Agent with AR: 3D body modeling, outfit simulation, auto-size prediction, returns probability score
AI Studio Page: user dashboard with Style Twin profile, saved outfits, AI suggestions, trend alerts
AI-powered shop search ('Ask AI'): natural language filtering e.g. 'casual black oversized hoodie under ₹2000'
LinkedIn and Instagram advertisement/social media integration and promotional content for the brand
Multi-stream revenue model: clothing sales, premium AI stylist subscription, capsule wardrobe packages, influencer AI collabs, B2B SaaS styling for other brands

Build the backend data model and API for the product catalog. Store clothing items with fields: id, name, category, price (INR), description, sizes, colors, tags, imageUrl, stock, and isTrending flag. Expose query functions: getAllProducts, getProductById, getProductsByCategory, and a keyword/tag-based search function (searchProducts) that accepts a natural language query string and returns matching products by matching against name, tags, category, and price range parsed from the query.

Build backend support for user Style Profiles. Each profile stores: userId (principal), bodyMeasurements (height, weight, chest, waist, hips), stylePreferences (array: streetwear, minimal, luxury, casual, formal), savedOutfits (array of outfit objects with product IDs), and trendAlerts (array of strings). Expose functions: createOrUpdateStyleProfile, getStyleProfile, saveOutfit, removeSavedOutfit.

Build backend support for Wardrobe Optimizer. Store a user's wardrobe items (productId or custom item name, category, color). Expose functions: addWardrobeItem, removeWardrobeItem, getWardrobe, and getWardrobeSuggestions which returns a list of product recommendations based on gaps in the user's wardrobe categories and colors.

Build backend support for Trend Radar. Maintain a curated list of trending items (populated by admin or seeded data) with fields: productId, trendScore, trendTags (e.g. 'streetwear 2025', 'earth tones'), and dateAdded. Expose: getTrendingItems, and getPersonalizedTrends(userId) which filters trending items by the user's style preferences.

Seed the backend with at least 20 realistic clothing products for the AURAWEAR catalog spanning categories: Tops, Bottoms, Outerwear, Accessories, Footwear. Include diverse tags (streetwear, minimal, luxury, casual, formal), price range ₹500–₹8000, multiple sizes, and varied colors. Mark 6–8 products as isTrending=true.
